script_text: This week, Venus fires a love arrow straight through your 7th House that you cannot ignore. Monday through Wednesday, the Sun in your 1st House squares Saturn in your 12th, draining your energy—Tuesday is the worst day, avoid major decisions. By Thursday, Mercury in Taurus sextiles Venus in your 5th House, sparking a candid conversation with someone you've been avoiding. The real turning point hits Friday when Venus conjuncts the Sun at 0 degrees Gemini, igniting a financial breakthrough and reigniting an old flame. Saturday through Sunday, Jupiter in Cancer trines your 9th House, bringing travel luck or a generous offer. Your power day is Friday when Venus-Sun merge in your 2nd House. Best day is Friday. Worst day is Tuesday. Anchor yourself before reacting Monday through Wednesday. Follow for daily updates.
